fields.label: Numbered questions / items
cites: NEWTON’S 3 LAWS OF MOTION  1. The Law of Inertia An object at rest stays at rest and an object in motion stays in motion unless acted upon by an outside force.  2. Force = Mass times Acceleration The greater the mass of the object, the greater the force needed to achieve the same change in motion. For any given object, a larger force causes a larger change in motion.  3. The Law of Action / Reaction For every action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
